accepted.definition: thin strip of metal used to separate lines of type in printing
accepted.simpleMeaning: a thin strip of metal put between rows of printed letters to space them out.
accepted.scope: This is a printing material, not the act of guiding a group or being in first place.
examples: The printer adjusted the leading to make the page easier to read.
Strips of leading separate the lines on this old press.
